cases.name: CHK-001 happy: docs state Koala owns project-state runtime, not agent runtime
cases.execute: const fs = await import("node:fs"); const read = (p) => fs.readFileSync($root + "/" + p, "utf8"); const text = read("README.md") + "\n" + read("docs/requirements/decisions/stack-layering.md"); return { hasProjectStateRuntime: text.includes("project-state runtime"), hasAgentRuntimeBoundary: text.includes("agent runtime"), hasStatusNext: text.includes("koala status") && text.includes("koala next") };

cases.name: CHK-001 edge: docs limit OMX borrowing to observable recoverable project-state ideas
cases.execute: const fs = await import("node:fs"); const text = fs.readFileSync($root + "/docs/requirements/decisions/stack-layering.md", "utf8"); return { mentionsOmxBorrowing: text.includes("借鉴 OMX"), mentionsKoalaStateProjection: text.includes(".koala/state"), rejectsSecondTruth: text.includes("第二真相源") };

cases.name: CHK-001 adversarial: docs do not promise Koala agent-runtime responsibilities
cases.execute: const fs = await import("node:fs"); const text = fs.readFileSync($root + "/docs/requirements/decisions/stack-layering.md", "utf8") + "\n" + fs.readFileSync($root + "/README.md", "utf8"); const forbidden = ["Koala 负责启动", "Koala 负责恢复 Codex", "Koala 负责调度 Codex", "通用 worker 池、prompt marketplace、token/model 管理或通知系统。"].slice(0,3); return forbidden.every((s) => !text.includes(s));

cases.name: CHK-002 happy: koala status shows project-state sections
cases.execute: const { execFileSync } = await import("node:child_process"); const out = execFileSync(process.execPath, ["packages/main/dist/cli.js", "status", "--concise"], { cwd: $root, encoding: "utf8" }); return { hasHeader: out.includes("# koala status"), hasStory: out.includes("**Story**") || out.includes("**Dashboard**"), hasRuntime: out.includes("Runtime health"), hasReviewer: out.includes("Reviewer status"), hasArtifacts: out.includes("Artifacts"), hasNext: out.includes("Next step") };

cases.name: CHK-002 edge: koala status works without .koala state projection
cases.execute: const fs = await import("node:fs"); const { execFileSync } = await import("node:child_process"); const out = execFileSync(process.execPath, ["packages/main/dist/cli.js", "status", "--concise"], { cwd: $root, encoding: "utf8" }); return { statusOk: out.includes("# koala status"), noStateDirRequired: !fs.existsSync($root + "/.koala/state"), noStateOutputDependency: !out.includes(".koala/state") };

cases.name: CHK-002 adversarial: koala status is read-only for state files and phase
cases.execute: const { execFileSync } = await import("node:child_process"); const tracked = ["--", ".koala", "docs/story/actives/B-3736/index.json"]; const before = execFileSync("git", ["status", "--short", ...tracked], { cwd: $root, encoding: "utf8" }); execFileSync(process.execPath, ["packages/main/dist/cli.js", "status", "--concise"], { cwd: $root, encoding: "utf8" }); const after = execFileSync("git", ["status", "--short", ...tracked], { cwd: $root, encoding: "utf8" }); return before === after;

cases.name: CHK-003 happy: koala next prints only an executable next-step line
cases.execute: const { execFileSync } = await import("node:child_process"); const out = execFileSync(process.execPath, ["packages/main/dist/cli.js", "next"], { cwd: $root, encoding: "utf8" }); return { startsWithNext: out.includes("Next step:"), mentionsPhase: out.includes("阶段") || out.includes("Resume:"), omitsBriefHeader: !out.includes("# koala session brief") && !out.includes("# koala status") };

cases.name: CHK-003 edge: next keeps PLAN artifact gap priority in computeNextStep
cases.execute: const fs = await import("node:fs"); const text = fs.readFileSync($root + "/packages/main/src/handlers/session.ts", "utf8"); return { checksMissingUnderstanding: text.includes("PLAN 阶段缺 understanding"), checksMissingDecision: text.includes("PLAN 阶段已有 understanding，缺 decision"), extractsSameNextStep: text.includes("## → Next step") && text.includes("renderNext") };

cases.name: CHK-003 adversarial: koala next is read-only and not a full brief
cases.execute: const { execFileSync } = await import("node:child_process"); const tracked = ["--", ".koala", "docs/story/actives/B-3736/index.json"]; const before = execFileSync("git", ["status", "--short", ...tracked], { cwd: $root, encoding: "utf8" }); const out = execFileSync(process.execPath, ["packages/main/dist/cli.js", "next"], { cwd: $root, encoding: "utf8" }); const after = execFileSync("git", ["status", "--short", ...tracked], { cwd: $root, encoding: "utf8" }); return { readOnly: before === after, compact: out.split("\n").filter(Boolean).length <= 3, noFullBrief: !out.includes("## Artifacts") && !out.includes("## Reviewer status") };
